headings.usage: Page titles, section headers, modal titles

body.usage: General text, form labels, table content

mono.usage: Asset tags, serial numbers, IP addresses, code snippets

primary.description: Electric Indigo - Use for primary actions, active states, and key highlights.

secondary.description: Slate 100 - Use for secondary buttons, backgrounds of subtle elements.

grid_system.card_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium shadow-sm

cards.base: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

inputs.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 transition-all duration-200 focus:border-primary

tables.wrapper: relative w-full overflow-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-white shadow-sm

badges.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

glassmorphism.header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/60 sticky top-0 z-50

dashboard_hero.usage: Welcome banner or empty state illustration

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px, size 16px-20px for UI, 24px for navigation

anti_ai_rules: Do NOT use gradients for text or buttons unless explicitly for a 'Pro' feature.
Do NOT center-align dashboard content. Use left alignment for readability.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Manrope'.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for any ID, Key, or Code-like data.

accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

interaction.hover: All interactive elements must have a visible hover state.
interaction.active: Buttons must have a scale-down effect (active:scale-95) on click.
interaction.loading: Use skeleton loaders instead of spinners for initial data fetch.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Ensure Tailwind config includes the custom colors and fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use Shadcn/UI components as a base but override styles with the 'components' guidelines above. Do not use default Shadcn styles blindly.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout: Implement the 'Bento' grid for the dashboard overview. Use the sidebar layout for the main app shell.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme: Default to Light Mode. Implement a theme toggle if requested, but prioritize the Light Mode experience.
